webapp.description: A Link Loom React webapp (client or admin) built from layers: the Mi Retail frame, Veripass, StoneOS and the Command Center

brand.description: Changes the brand of a webapp (colours, logo) and rebuilds the theme, favicons, PWA icons and share image

entity.description: Adds a CRUD for one entity from the kit of @link-loom/react-sdk: list, record (over the list and as a page), service, routes, sidebar row, Omnisearch category, en/es copy and tests

page.description: Adds a page of a domain: the page, its component on the kit, its route, en/es copy, its test and (with the Command Center) its companion; optionally a sidebar row

component.description: Adds a component, shared or of a domain, with its test

service.description: Adds a service on BaseApi for one backend entity (Link Loom contract) with its test

hook.description: Adds a hook with its test

nav-item.description: Adds a sidebar row with its en/es label

settings-section.description: Adds a card to Advanced settings with its en/es copy

platform-section.description: Adds a card to a platform's page of Advanced settings (stoneos layer)

copy.description: Adds one text to both dictionaries under a dotted key

feature.description: Adds a capability after create: images (manifest, masters folder, gen/optimize/og scripts)

seo.description: SEO of a page (title, description, share image)

route.description: A route for a page that has none
